threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'the bus' means the number 38, not the 48 or the night buses that keep you awake after 1am.
Caught the 333 last night; a guy serenaded the whole bus with 90s R&B. Only in Brixton would the driver join in and the passengers clap along.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a group of kids building a massive sandcastle in the middle of the street while the traffic just flowed around them.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice the spontaneous street performances at Görlitzer Park? It's like an unfiltered slice of life, always something unexpected happening.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from the Mission if they can spot a taco truck from three blocks away, even buried behind construction.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 31 mixing tracks with his beatbox while the driver took a breather. Classic SF: even the commute has a soundtrack.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'Gràcia' is just the square; they miss the hidden murals and the tiny plazas where locals sip coffee, away from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a new arrival by their confusion over the 3-hour lunch siesta—watch them try to order food at 4 PM.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot a new face when they look baffled by the bus service after 9 PM; locals know to rely on night buses or just walk it.
Last night on the 59, a guy was loudly reciting Shakespeare. Brixton's night bus passengers are wilder than you'd think, Shakespeare included.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a couple haggling over antique vinyls at the Sunday market, while kids danced to a street musician's tune. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you grab a currywurst from a vendor while dodging trams, all in the shadow of an East Side Gallery mural. It's a chaotic art walk!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they navigate the BART delays; they’ve figured out which coffee shop to hit before heading home to avoid the chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo giving a speech to an empty 38 bus yesterday. Only in SF do you get pre-wedding jitters on the Muni.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve tapas after 11 PM; locals know that most kitchens close by 10.30 and that the real vibe is found in the late-night vermut spots.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they’re recent by the way they stare blankly at the Metro map, still not used to the labyrinth of lines.
